title: Mobile views for Front, Signal, Proposals and the Table
description:
Match the HomeMobile, ItemMobile and ProposalsMobile artboards and the mobile Table (https://claude.ai/artifact/EoXGtpzsayij4d7tmrfZ9r) at 390 px. The Table scrolls horizontally inside its own box, with column headers pinned.

Acceptance: no horizontal page scroll at 390 px on any rebuilt page.
